'''Liers Ossnan''' was an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was in charge of finding the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']]. The investigation proceeded after a [[message pod]] from the ship was found near [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] and brought to the [[Space station/Legends|station]].
